Which of the following Tuple Relational Calculus (TRC) expressions is/are UNSAFE?

💡 Detailed Concept & Solution:
A query is safe if all its result tuples are composed of constants from the domain of the database instance ($ ext{DOM}(Q)$).
A is UNSAFE: $\neg(t \in R)$ generates infinitely many tuples not present in $R$.
B is SAFE: $t[A]$ is bounded by values in $R$, and $t[B]=5$ is a constant in the query.
C is SAFE: Tuples are bounded by $R \cup S$.
D is UNSAFE: A tuple $t$ satisfying the universal quantifier can contain attributes outside $ ext{DOM}(Q)$ or generate arbitrary values when $R$ is empty.
